text:
Samir: FYI PartnerX flagged a bunch of missing hourly heartbeats this week \u2014 ~0.15% of rows. Not huge but it causes under-credited usage. Any thoughts: heuristics to reconstruct vs SLA exemption?
Alyssa: not a fan of SLA exemptions for partner bugs. prefer best-effort reconstruction + flagging so CS can reconcile.
Miguel: agree. we should avoid retro credits unless we can prove intent/volume. can we infer usage from cumulative counters in the next heartbeat?
Jordan: PartnerX heartbeats sometimes include a cumulative \"total_usage\" field when they resume. idea: if gap <= 4 hours and next heartbeat has delta>0, split delta evenly across missing hours and mark records as inferred.
Maria: also need audit trail + separate ingestion tag so billing teams can filter inferred rows. cs wants visibility before we auto-credit.
partner-billing-bot: Alert: PartnerX last heartbeat missing 2026-03-17T22:00Z -> 2026-03-18T01:00Z (3 hours). signature ok on resume.
Samir: proposal sketch: policy per-partner {\"max_infer_gap_hours\": 4, \"min_delta_threshold\": 1000, \"mark_inferred\": true}. only apply if delta >= threshold so we don't fabricate tiny amounts.
Alyssa: +1 on threshold. also we should run a dry-run mode for 2 weeks: create inferred rows in staging, surface to GA dashboards and CS, but don't auto-credit. after signoff turn on synthetic credits.
Miguel: SQL to detect candidate gaps (quick):
```sql
-- find gaps where next cumulative > prev and gap <= 4h
with hb as (select partner_id, ts, total_usage, lead(ts) over (partition by partner_id order by ts) as next_ts, lead(total_usage) over (partition by partner_id order by ts) as next_total from partner_heartbeats)
select partner_id, ts, next_ts, next_total - total_usage as delta, extract(epoch from (next_ts - ts))/3600 as gap_hours
from hb
where next_total > total_usage and extract(epoch from (next_ts - ts))/3600 <= 4;
```
Jordan: thanks. For idempotency: when we materialize inferred rows, include source_tag=\"inferred_v1_partnerx\" + original_window_hash so replays don't duplicate.
Maria: ops questions: telemetry/alerts? we need an alert threshold when inferred > 0.5% of daily usage for partner. also add runbook for CS escalation.
Samir: rollout plan: 1) add detection + dry-run in staging (1 day) 2) run dry-run 14 days, surface dashboard + CSV for CS 3) agree on threshold w/ PartnerX 4) enable auto-credit with guardrails and daily audit.
Alyssa: timeline: can eng deliver staging dry-run in 5 working days?
Miguel: yes, I can lane this, ETA Fri next week. will create a PR with config and migration, and add partner-specific policy UI hooks.
Jordan: I'll add a dashboard tile: \"inferred credits % by partner\" and a slow alert.
Maria: I'll notify PartnerX with the plan and ask for acknowledgement. CS will keep a manual hold until we get signoff.
Samir: ok. followups: @Miguel open a GH issue and tag eng-ml/eng-platform; @Jordan add dashboard and alert; @Maria coordinate partner comms and CS signoff.
Alyssa: one more: keep a flag to exclude certain SKUs (e.g., trial SKUs) from inference. add to policy schema.
Miguel: noted. I'll include sku_exclude list in the policy.
partner-billing-bot: Note: created issue #PB-482: partnerx-inference-dryrun.
Samir: great, thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after 2-week dry-run and decide on auto-credit enablement. :thumbsup:
